notes.title: Arcane Chaos Beta 0.6
notes.content:
This is likely to be the last patch before Arcane Chaos leaves early access sometime next week. Just finishing up adding a few more soul spells, doing final optimizations and balance adjustments and then it should be done. 

[i][u][b]Changes: [/b][/u][/i]

- Lots of general optimization has been done to try and improve performance.

- Bosses and Elites can no longer be pushed around by other mobs.

- Lightning Bubble will now explode into smaller projectiles when hitting an enemy.

- Base spawn rate increased slightly for "Courtyard" and "Treasure Island" levels 

[i][u][b]New Additions:[/b][/u][/i]

- New Passive "Mana Shield" has been added to the pool of abilities. Mana Shield will periodically recharge blocking one instance of damage, recharge time decreasing with each level.

- Purple XP gems will now condense into blue gems when there are enough of them in an area, this should help reduce clutter and improve performance later in levels when the amount of gems being dropped is extremely high.

- Added a few new optional bosses that can be found and triggered throughout levels 2,3 and 4

- Added a score screen after levels where stats from that run are displayed as well as a breakdown on how much damage each spell did. You will also gain bonus gold based on your performance.

- New Soul Spell "Cold Snap" added

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PS: I know "Arcane Chaos" isn't the most polished of games nor the most unique but it's been a quite the learning experience as my first excursion into game development and I already can't wait to apply what I've learned to bigger and better things going forward. Thanks to all those who purchased the game and I hope to exceed any expectations with my future projects.

notes.title: Arcane Chaos Beta 0.5.1
notes.content:
[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

-Fixed a bug causing Lightning Bubble to not continue its trajectory after arriving at the location of its original target.

-Fixed bug with Thunderstorm causing it not to create lightning bolts.


After some feedback I've decided to make the following balance changes to slightly increase the strength of the various spells and reduce base difficulty. Hopefully this will help make the game more forgiving when first starting as well as speed up progress.

[u][b]Changes: [/b][/u]

Gold drop rate increased by 50% (from 4% chance to 6% per enemy)

[b]Basic Spell Changes: [/b]

	- Fireball damage per level increased from 35 to 40

	- Lightning Bolt damage per level increased from 70 to 75

	- Immolation damage per level increased from 8 to 9 and base cooldown lowered from 0.8s to 0.66

	- Solar Ray damage per level increased from 20 to 25

	- Earthen Spire damage per level increased from 35 to 40

	- Vortex Blades damage per level increased from 25 to 30

[b]Fusion Spell Changes:[/b]

	- Eruption damage increased from 425 to 500 and cooldown decreased from 1 second to 0.9 seconds
	
	- Static Field damage increased from 125 to 135

	- Superheated damage increased from 800 to 1000

	- Ray Gun damage increased from 235 to 250

	- Dragon's Breath damage increased from 205 to 220

	- Bifurcation damage increased from 425 to 450

	- Meteor cooldown reduced from 1.75 seconds to 1.5 seconds

	- Wrath of Ra damage increased from 250 to 450

	- Poseidon's Fury damage increased from 600 to 700

	- Namikiri damage reduced from 900 to 800 and cooldown decreased from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds
	
	- Unstable Plasma cooldown decreased from 0.66 seconds to 0.5 seconds

	- Hells Wake damage increased from 222 to 260

	- Frostfire Cascade damage increased from 260 to 300

	- Blitzwelle damage increased from 660 to 700

notes.title: Arcane Chaos Beta 0.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug causing a couple fusion spells to not deal damage.

- Fixed a bug with "Meteor" that could sometimes cause the game to crash.

- Mobs will properly reposition themselves on level 4 when they get too far away from the player.

- Fixed a bug causing elites to sometimes spawn dead




Changes: 

- Increased spawn rate slightly on levels 2,3, and 4 

- Increased mob HP slightly on level 4 "Treasure Island"




New Additions:

- 5 New passive upgrades can appear in game during level up
	
	- Flat spell damage
	- Movespeed
	- Multicast Chance
	- Spell Recharge Rate*
	- Hp Regen

*Note Spell Recharge Rate scales multiplicatively with Cooldown Reduction not additively.*

notes.title: Arcane Chaos Beta 0.3
notes.content:
[u][b]New Additions:
[/b][/u]
- Bosses now have Health Bars

- The Option to take no item has been added to chests

- More Upgrades Options:
	- Xp gain increase
	- reroll
	- Spell Penetration
	- Spell Size

- Boss Soul System: 
	
	Defeating some bosses will give you access to their "Soul Spell" a unique and powerful ability which you can select in the Upgrades menu. These spells are activated by the player pressing the spacebar and take significant time to recharge, which will be indicated by a the new Soul Spell gauge.

notes.title: Arcane Chaos Beta 0.2
notes.content:
[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
- Fixed many random bugs that were resulting in crashes, the game should be significantly more stable.
- Earthen Spire fragments will no longer hit enemies already damaged by the intial spire.
- Fireball splash damage will now only deal half the original damage to surrounding enemies, as originally intended

[u][b]Changes: [/b][/u]
- Gold gained from gold drops increased from 5 to 10
- Magnet Gem size increased to be easier to spot
- Many small and large balance changes to various spell
- The leveling curve has been adjusted to make xp required a bit less in the early levels allowing players to get their first fusion spell earlier while increasing xp requirements at higher levels.

[u][b]New Additions:[/b][/u]
- Level 3, "Courtyard" has been added.
